verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question for a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that the root URL returns a JavaScript application shell and that a legacy entry path returns 404. Nothing in the pack documents API keys, tokens, scopes or any programmatic credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
